reader.requirement: A COLUMN NUMBER clause is refused on any report group entry that is not elementary (a group entry, including the 1985 format 1 level-01 entry) and on any elementary entry that neither contains a LINE NUMBER clause nor is subordinate to one that does; it is accepted otherwise. The witness covers the accepted forms only.
